settings.intro_highlight: Eliminating the frustrating delays of single-temperature wax melting, this dual-tank aesthetic heating station guarantees continuous workflow during high-volume hair removal services, engineered to exacting North American manufacturing standards for the rigorous demands of the busy professional environment.
settings.custom_description: Duo-Pil Standard is purpose-built for licensed professionals, including professional estheticians, brow artists, and advanced aesthetic specialists. Its fully adjustable thermal control targets workflow disruption during back-to-back appointments, enabling sharper focus on service consistency and enhanced client comfort. Whether you are performing full-body hair removal, precision facial waxing, or sensitive skin treatments, this professional station adjusts to your seamless workflow integration with instant-response calibration and friction-free adjustment.
settings.subtitle: Precision Dual-Temperature Heating Technology
settings.secondary_description: Consistent reliability is central to the Equipro approach. To preserve the rapid-heating efficiency and professional appearance of the Duo-Pil Standard, wipe the exterior with professional wax solvent formulated for salon environments daily. The heavy-duty metallic chassis resists structural degradation, ensuring optimal heat retention across years of high-volume usage. Consistent care prevents residue buildup, guaranteeing seamless temperature calibration.

settings.question: Professional Waxing Specialist:
settings.answer: High-volume waxing specialists can maintain soft wax in one tank and hard wax in the other simultaneously, eliminating wait times and streamlining back-to-back body and facial waxing services.

settings.question: Brow and Lash Artist:
settings.answer: Allows precision control over smaller, delicate wax batches alongside main service supplies, ensuring optimal viscosity for facial sculpting and sensitive areas.

settings.question: Advanced Aesthetic Technician:
settings.answer: Dual 3-5/8" and 4" chambers accept both Canadian/European and US format containers seamlessly, fitting easily into multi-service clinic setups.

settings.shipping_text: Standard delivery typically takes 5-7 business days, while expedited shipping takes 2-3 business days.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Place standard professional wax tins (14oz to 20oz) directly into the corresponding 3 5/8" or 4" heating tanks.
Turn on the master power switch to initiate the 250W heating elements.
Adjust each independent thermostat to the specific melting point required for your soft or hard wax type.
Allow the unit to rapidly heat the product, then dial down to the desired maintenance temperature.
Turn off the station and unplug the unit at the end of the shift prior to surface cleaning.
Always test the wax temperature on a small area of skin before applying it to the client to prevent burns.
Do not pour wax directly into the heating tanks; always use the appropriate inserted metal or professional plastic containers.
Never operate the heating station near water sources or leave it unattended while powered on.

settings.question: What size wax cans fit in the Duo-Pil Standard?
settings.answer: It features dual wells: one 3-5/8" chamber (Canadian/European format) and one 4" chamber (US format), accommodating standard 14oz to 20oz wax cans.

settings.question: Can I melt hard and soft wax at the same time?
settings.answer: Yes, the dual independent thermostats allow you to heat soft wax and hard wax at different temperatures simultaneously.

settings.question: Does this unit come with empty wax containers?
settings.answer: Empty aluminum cassolette containers (Model 42100) and lids (Model 42099) are sold separately.

settings.question: How fast does the wax melt?
settings.answer: The 250W heating element provides an ultra-rapid heat-up function to melt wax quickly before switching to maintenance mode.

settings.question: Is the temperature control digital or manual?
settings.answer: It features two independent manual thermostat control dials with individual red power toggle switches.

settings.question: How long is the manufacturer warranty?
settings.answer: The Duo-Pil Standard includes a 2-Year Limited Warranty covering both parts and labor.
